evidence.title: AI Agents for Beginners - A Course
GitHub - microsoft/ai-agents-for-beginners: 18 Lessons to Get Started Building AI Agents

name: AI Agents for Beginners
summary: Microsoft's 18-lesson course on building AI agents, with videos, Python code samples and 50+ translations.
description: A course of 18 lessons on building AI agents, from agent use cases and design patterns through tool use, agentic RAG, planning, multi-agent systems, agentic protocols (MCP, A2A, NLWeb), context engineering and production. Each lesson includes a written lesson, a short video, Python code samples built on Microsoft Agent Framework with Microsoft Foundry Agent Service V2, and links to extra resources.
contains: each lesson: written lesson, short video, Python code samples, extra links
50+ language translations maintained by a GitHub Action
code samples use Microsoft Agent Framework with Microsoft Foundry Agent Service V2 (Azure account required)
